high_level_description: This image features a close-up of a bouquet of light pink roses arranged in a clear glass vase. The roses are in various stages of bloom, with some fully open and others still in bud form. The green leaves of the roses are visible, adding a fresh and natural touch to the arrangement. The vase is placed on a dark surface, possibly a table or countertop, which contrasts nicely with the light color of the flowers. In the background, there is a window with white frames, through which a view of a building can be seen.
